_about: Where HullGrade's placed looks go on each hull, by hand, because finding them in the pixels put them anywhere (Jon, Oct 14: running lights 'random and bad', markings 'the execution is bad'). Keyed by the hull's path under art/sprites/hulls/ without .png; coordinates in that picture's own pixels (the full-size file). plate: the registry plate, [x, y, w, h], 7 rows tall for the 3x5 stencil with a pixel round it. chevrons: the tip of the first S-grade chevron on the nose, [x, y]; two are drawn, pointing forward. windows: [x, y] of each 2x2 window, aft to fore. nav: [x, y, 'white' | 'amber'] running lights.
